questions.question: What makes the glass forest a place worth exploring?
choices: It preserves people and buildings from a vanished kingdom.
It is advancing toward the sanctuary each night.
Its branches repeat sounds from possible futures.
questions.recommended_answer: It is advancing toward the sanctuary each night.

questions.question: What gives the sanctuary its unmistakable silhouette?
choices: A city built around a broken astronomical ring.
A monastery suspended between two stone needles.
A fortress terraced inside an enormous petrified tree.
questions.recommended_answer: A city built around a broken astronomical ring.

questions.question: What decision should the geography make interesting?
choices: A safe bridge versus a dangerous mountain pass.
A short route through glass versus a long river detour.
Three rival roads controlled by different settlements.
questions.recommended_answer: A short route through glass versus a long river detour.
